prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: draw each object inside its grey box, as described. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the first box from the left in the top row of boxes (48x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a dark-green conifer (fir) tree seen in three-quarter view: a tall layered cone of needles in two or three greens with darker shading on the right, and a short brown trunk at the bottom centre.
- the second box from the left in the top row of boxes (96x96 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a round town-square fountain of pale grey stone seen in three-quarter view: a low round basin full of blue water with a small central pillar and a little spout of water, filling most of the box.
- the third box from the left in the top row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a round leafy green bush, about as wide as the box, with lighter leaves on the upper left.
- the fourth box from the left in the middle row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a small round stone well with a little wooden roof on two posts and a bucket, about as wide as the box.
- the first box from the left in the middle row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). one section of a white wooden picket fence running left to right: two horizontal rails that touch both the left and the right edge of the box (so sections join into a long fence), with three pointed pickets, in the lower half of the box.
- the second box from the left in the middle row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). one section of the same white picket fence running away from the viewer (top to bottom): a narrow vertical run of rails and pickets in the centre of the box, touching the top and bottom edges.
- the third box from the left in the middle row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a single square white wooden fence post with a pointed cap, in the lower part of the box.
- the fourth box from the left in the bottom row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a small low patch of flowers: red, yellow and white blossoms among green leaves, covering the lower half of the box.
- the first box from the left in the bottom row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a wooden barrel with dark iron hoops, standing upright, a bit narrower than the box.
- the second box from the left in the bottom row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a wooden crate of light planks with darker corner boards, a bit narrower than the box.
- the third box from the left in the bottom row of boxes (48x48 sprite pixels): ONE object standing on the bottom edge of its box, as large as the box allows, with magenta all around it (no ground, no shadow on the ground, no grass under it). a wooden signpost: one post with a blank wooden board pointing right, as tall as the box.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
